name: Helion
description_en:
Helion presents hiring, payroll and equity administration as live modules built around one employee record. Its current homepage positions the product for enterprise operations and lists India, UAE and Singapore as intended markets, while its Finance module is explicitly marked coming soon.

The useful evaluation question is whether a hire, salary change or equity event reaches the right payroll records with correct approval and tax treatment. The site’s animated hire-to-finance example is a product illustration, not proof that the upcoming finance function is available or that reconciliation can never be necessary.
description_zh:
Helion 将招聘、工资及股权管理列为已上线模块，围绕同一员工档案构建。当前首页定位企业运营，列出印度、阿联酋、新加坡市场，但 Finance 财务模块明确标为即将推出。

评估重点是录用、薪资变更或股权事件能否在正确审批及税务处理下进入工资记录。官网从录用到财务的动画只是产品演示，不能证明尚未推出的财务功能已可用，也不能证明永远无需对账。

core_features.explanation_en: The live Hiring ATS describes requisitions, interviews, offers and onboarding linked to an employee record.
core_features.explanation_zh: 已上线 Hiring ATS 描述岗位申请、面试、录用和入职与员工档案相连。

core_features.name_zh: 含印度法定输出的工资模块
core_features.explanation_en: The live payroll module lists salary structures, TDS, PF, ESI, PT, Form 24Q/TRACES/FVU and final settlement.
core_features.explanation_zh: 已上线工资模块列出薪资结构、TDS、PF、ESI、PT、Form 24Q/TRACES/FVU 和离职结算。

core_features.explanation_en: The live Equity module describes cap tables, vesting schedules and exercise workflows for listed and unlisted companies.
core_features.explanation_zh: 已上线 Equity 模块描述上市及未上市公司的资本结构表、归属计划和行权流程。

pricing.summary_en: Walkthrough and sales inquiry required; no numeric rates, plan limits or implementation terms were verified.
pricing.summary_zh: 需要演示和销售咨询，未核实数值费率、套餐上限或实施条件。

sources.title: Helion — Hiring · Payroll · ESOP · Accounting. One system.
sources.research_notes_en: Read live versus coming-soon labels, shared record model, hiring, payroll and equity details; excluded roadmap finance from live features.

sources.title: Contact Helion — Book a Walkthrough
sources.research_notes_en: Read official walkthrough request; no prices, plan limits or trial terms were disclosed.

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Separate live modules from the finance roadmap
sections.title_zh: 区分已上线模块与财务规划
sections.en: The homepage labels Hiring ATS, Payroll and Equity as live, and Finance as coming soon. Its Finance description includes accounting, GST, inventory, consolidation and FP&A, but those roadmap statements are not included in the verified live capability list. The same page visually shows automatic journal posting in a hire example, creating a boundary buyers must clarify: which accounting outputs are available now, and which require the future module? The original catalog slug containing ERP is retained for continuity; it is not evidence of a currently delivered complete ERP.
sections.zh: 首页将 Hiring ATS、Payroll、Equity 标为已上线，将 Finance 标为即将推出。财务介绍涵盖会计、GST、库存、合并及 FP&A，但这些规划不纳入已上线能力表。同页又在录用示例中展示自动记账，买家需澄清边界：当前可交付哪些会计输出，哪些依赖未来模块？原目录含 ERP 的 slug 仅为连续性保留，不能证明已交付完整 ERP。

sections.title_en: Use a new hire as the first acceptance case
sections.title_zh: 用新录用人员做首个验收案例
sections.en: Helion describes requisitions, pipelines, interviews, offer letters and onboarding, with accepted offers creating a payroll-ready employee. A practical demonstration should follow a fictional hire from acceptance into the employee record and salary structure, then inspect approvals and an intentional correction. The homepage’s named candidate, salary, tax deduction and option grant are illustrative values, not a real payroll calculation or customer result. Claims such as zero manual steps or structurally impossible reconciliation were not independently verified and should not replace checks on source data and exceptions.
sections.zh: Helion 描述岗位申请、候选流程、面试、录用信和入职，并称接受录用后创建可用于工资处理的员工。演示应跟踪虚构新员工从接受录用到档案和薪资结构，检查审批并故意更正一次错误。首页候选人姓名、工资、扣税和期权数量属于示例值，不是真实工资计算或客户结果。“零人工步骤”“结构上不可能对账”等说法未经独立验证，不能代替原始数据及异常检查。

sections.title_en: Check payroll and equity rules independently
sections.title_zh: 分别核对工资与股权规则
sections.en: The payroll description names Indian statutory outputs and handling for loans, reimbursements and full-and-final settlement. Equity covers cap-table management, vesting and exercise, and the vendor says vesting-related perquisite tax reaches the payslip. These are product claims rather than tax advice. For a pilot, specify grant terms and a salary period, then compare the expected vesting event, taxable treatment and payroll output using an independently approved rule set. India, UAE and Singapore are listed as supported markets, but the source does not enumerate equivalent live filings or tax treatment for all three.
sections.zh: 工资介绍列出印度法定输出，以及借款、报销和离职结算。股权模块涵盖资本结构、归属和行权，供应商称归属相关福利税会进入工资单。这些属于产品声明，并非税务建议。试运行时应指定授予条款及工资期间，再依据另行认可的规则核对归属事件、税务处理及工资输出。虽然页面列出支持印度、阿联酋和新加坡，却没有逐一列明三地等同的已上线申报或税务能力。

sections.title_en: Request a walkthrough and explicit commercial terms
sections.title_zh: 预约演示并明确商务条件
sections.en: The official contact page offers a company inquiry and walkthrough request; it does not publish prices, billing units, plan limits, trial duration or implementation fees. Obtain a proposal stating the live modules, employee and entity counts, market coverage, implementation, support and any future-module commitments. A sign-in link establishes an access route, not a free plan. The single shared data-model description also does not determine whether a buyer can self-host or receive source code; no open-source license was established.
sections.zh: 官方联系页提供企业咨询和演示申请，未公布价格、计费单位、套餐上限、试用期限或实施费。需取得明确已上线模块、员工及实体数、市场覆盖、实施、支持和未来模块承诺的方案。登录入口不证明存在免费套餐。共享数据模型的描述也不能决定买家是否能自托管或取得源代码，本研究未确立开源许可。

sections.title_en: Evaluate the shared-record premise with exceptions
sections.title_zh: 用异常场景评估共享档案
sections.en: Helion may fit a team evaluating combined hiring, payroll and equity, especially where Indian payroll outputs matter. An organization requiring live inventory, multi-entity finance or a proven accounting replacement should not rely on the coming-soon section. Before adoption, require a demonstration of a rejected hire change, retrospective salary correction, altered equity schedule and reconciliation output. Actual availability was checked only at the vendor’s page-label level; no account, performance benchmark or transaction was tested. Hosting, authentication controls, permission granularity, audit history, backup, export completeness and recovery remain unverified.
sections.zh: 需要组合招聘、工资及股权管理，尤其关注印度工资输出的团队，可以评估 Helion。要求当前即可使用库存、多实体财务或成熟会计替代产品的组织，不应依赖即将推出的章节。采用前应演示拒绝人员变更、追溯薪资更正、股权计划修改及对账输出。可用性仅核对至供应商页面标签，未测试账户、性能或交易；托管、认证控制、细粒度权限、审计历史、备份、完整导出和恢复均未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: The live status is vendor-labeled only; no account or payroll/equity transaction was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 上线状态仅依据供应商标签，未测试账户或工资股权交易。

research_gaps.en: Finance is marked coming soon; current journal output, regional filings, hosting, export and recovery are unresolved.
research_gaps.zh: Finance 标为即将推出；当前记账输出、地区申报、托管、导出和恢复尚未明确。
